sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:174

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:174:1
items.html: Leah was already corrected back to back before Rachel etc. And the two of them are still separate. As written above, that there is no beginning to the correction of Rachel except after ZA has attained Mochin of Neshama; for then Leah is reckoned as the great Nukva, who clothes him from the Chazeh [chest] upward, while the small Nukva, who is Rachel, clothes him from the Chazeh downward. And then the two of them are separate, for so long as there is not in ZA anything of the discernment of Mochin of Haya, he must be divided into two Partzufim, since the Mochin of SAG do not suffice to bestow the discernment of GAR to the place that is from the Chazeh downward, as above (page 1730, the passage beginning “And the explanation”); see there.
